_note: Every threshold lives here. Edit, then restart the backend. Points are NIFTY index points.

instruments._vix_note: INDIA VIX in IDX_I. The backend checks Dhan's scrip master on start and overrides this if it differs.

session._trade_windows_note: Indian 'kill zones': after the opening range settles, and the post-lunch institutional window. No new paper entries outside these.
session._expiry_note: Tuesday (Mon=0). Only used as a label - real expiry dates always come from Dhan's expiry list.

data._backfill_note: 1-minute candles fetched on start (one call; Dhan allows 90 days per call). 30 days gives the 1h chart ~200 bars.

engine._fvg_note: FVG kept only if size >= max(fvg_min_pts, fvg_min_atr x ATR). OB needs a displacement break: body >= displacement_body_atr x ATR AND body >= displacement_body_ratio of range, OR the leg left an FVG.

alerts._note: Info alerts (BOS, OTE touch) show in the app; only trade setups go to Telegram unless send_info_alerts is true.

paper._lot_note: NIFTY lot = 65 (same as your Paper Desk). Paper P&L is index points x lot_size, a rough proxy for an ITM option. The app never places real orders.
paper._premium_note: Entry/SL/TP stay on NIFTY index levels. P&L also recorded in option premium of the strike selected at entry (long CE for longs, long PE for shorts), from that strike's 1m candles.

zones._note: Zone registry: liquidity pools, order blocks and FVGs in one record shape. Ids come from candle timestamps, so a REST re-download never duplicates a zone.
zones._forward_note: A stored timestamp (mitigated_at, invalidated_at...) is never moved or cleared, and state never goes backwards.
zones._void_note: If corrected candles no longer produce a stored zone created inside the recomputed window, it is marked 'void' (e.g. a fake FVG from a feed stall). History is kept, never deleted.

delta._note: Positive delta = buyers attacking (market buys > market sells). Negative = sellers attacking. NIFTY index has no volume: delta needs futures footprint data, a CSV, or the mock (dev only).
delta._adapter_note: none (Unavailable, default) | footprint_feed (Real-feed: stub until wired) | csv | mock (deterministic fake, banner, never stored)
delta._coverage_note: For a 5m/15m/1h candle built from 1m CSV rows, at least this share of the minutes must have data, else delta = unavailable for that candle.
delta._baseline_note: zscore: (delta - mean)/std of the previous baseline_window CLOSED candles (the current candle is never in its own baseline). percentile: |delta| rank vs the same window.
delta._min_range_note: Candles with range < this x ATR are skipped for absorption/flip/imbalance (a flat feed-stall candle is not 'low progress').
delta._min_abs_note: Ignore 'extreme' delta smaller than this many contracts. 0 = off. Set it once you know your data's scale.

absorption._rule1_note: Low progress = body/range <= rule1_max_body_ratio OR the close sits >= rule1_min_close_off_extreme x range away from the extreme in the delta's direction.
absorption._rule2_note: Failure to continue = the NEXT closed candle does not close beyond the entry candle's close by max(pts, atr x ATR) in the delta's direction. Event is stamped on that next candle (no look-ahead).

flip._note: Delta sign change between closed candles, both |z| >= min_z, at a zone or within max_bars after a sweep.

footprint._mode_note: diagonal: ask(buy) at price p vs bid(sell) at p - 1 level (standard footprint). horizontal: buy vs sell at the same price.
footprint._stacked_note: N or more consecutive imbalanced levels on one side = a stacked imbalance (where aggression hit).

proxy._note: Without price levels: delta spike + a wick >= min_wick_ratio of the range in the delta's direction, at a zone = 'Proxy imbalance' (labelled, never called footprint).

confluence._note: Only adjusts confidence of Setup A/C. Never creates, removes or changes a trade or its status.

options_context._note: Focused-strike OI read vs the setup direction. Context only.

strikes._note: Strike selection = the OC 'Strike Advisor' (strike_advisor_pro.py: scenarios + pick + path_levels), unchanged. Defaults below are the OC values.
strikes._expiry_note: 0 = nearest expiry from Dhan's expiry list, 1 = next.
strikes._stop_note: OC 'Stop (NIFTY pts)' default — MJ's fixed 40-pt stop.
strikes._hold_note: OC 'Hold (min)' default — sets the theta cost.
strikes._target_note: fixed = OC 'Fixed pts'; first_level = OC 'First level' (first wall / max pain / gamma / prev close / open within reach).
strikes._reach_note: OC fallback reach when the straddle σ is unknown (olab_pro move_map not ported).

filters._note: Optional pre-filters BEFORE the OC rule. null/0 = off (OC behaviour).

strikes._switch_note: Scores refresh on every chain update (~60 s); the active strike may change only on a 3-minute close and only if the new best scores 15 % better (or the old one stops qualifying).
strikes._candle_note: Option 1m candles come from REST /charts/intraday (NSE_FNO/OPTIDX) a few seconds after each minute closes — closed candles only, Dhan's own numbers.

options_flow_proxy._note: PROXY (not real delta). Opt-in. Uses only observable option data: LTP change x volume per closed candle on the SELECTED CE and PE. Emits PROXY_FLOW_* events only.
